interface.signature: def createTree(parent: List[int], N: int) -> TreeNode:

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) for x in parent)
preconditions.description: All elements in parent[] must be integers.
The length of parent[] must equal N.
Exactly one element in parent[] must be -1 (the root).

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x < N for x in parent)
preconditions.description: All elements in parent[] must be valid node indices (0 ≤ x < N).

postconditions.expression: return_value is None or isinstance(return_value, TreeNode)
postconditions.description: The function returns either None or a TreeNode object.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(node, TreeNode) for node in [return_value] + [node.left for node in tree_nodes] + [node.right for node in tree_nodes])
postconditions.description: All nodes in the tree (root and children) are TreeNode objects.
Each node in the tree is uniquely identified by its index (0 to N-1).

postconditions.expression: all(node.parent == parent[node.index] for node in tree_nodes if node.index != root_index)
postconditions.description: For every node (except root), its parent attribute matches the parent[] array.

postconditions.expression: all(node.left is None or node.left.index == left_child for node in tree_nodes if (left_child := next((i for i in range(N) if parent[i] == node.index), None)) is not None)
postconditions.description: For each node, its left child is the first child in the array (if any).

postconditions.expression: all(node.right is None or node.right.index == right_child for node in tree_nodes if (right_child := next((i for i in range(N) if parent[i] == node.index and i != left_child), None)) is not None)
postconditions.description: For each node, its right child is the second child in the array (if any).
The root node is the one with parent -1.
